title: Customer Activation Sentinel and Acceptance Checklist for Beta Conversion
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Define a lightweight, verifiable acceptance checklist and launch sentinel for converting Early Access beta customers into production (GA) customers. Scope: 1) onboarding and first-week activation checks, 2) launch communications and release notes coordination, 3) quantitative gating metrics, 4) feedback capture and action loop, 5) post-conversion success signals and handoff to CSM. This ticket captures cross-functional tasks, decision points, and the run-of-operations for the first 12 lighthouse/early-access accounts targeted for conversion in Q2.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding: 80% of cohort complete 'first request' within 48 hours of enablement
Time-to-first-value: median time <= 72 hours for integration + latency < 250ms p50 on host region
Stability: fewer than 2 severity-1/2 incidents across cohort during 14-day observation window
Quality: automated regression evals show no >5% drop in prompt-quality signals for critical flows
Support: average initial CSAT >= 4.0 from post-onboarding survey (1-5 scale)
Documentation: release notes and integration guide published and linked in onboarding email before enablement
Telemetry: per-account token cost and latency dashboards configured and accessible to PM/CSM/Eng
Handoff: at least 6 positive adoption indicators for 60% of converted accounts before handing to standard CSM operations
tasks: Draft GA-adjacent release notes and one-line integration highlights (owner: Luca)
Create onboarding checklist with SDK snippets and sample prompts (owner: DevRel)
Define incident escalation path and runbook for pilot cohort (owner: SRE)
Schedule weekly feedback sync with 12 pilot contacts; create feedback intake form (owner: CS)
Design short CSAT survey and NPS proxy to run at day-7 and day-30 (owner: Growth)
Coordinate marketing enablement assets for lighthouse case studies (owner: Growth)
Set canary rollback and fallback model variants policy if error rate > threshold (owner: ML Infra)
Finalize success criteria and sign-off checklist with Eng/Design/Legal (owner: PM)
Publish GA readiness summary and sign-off to execs two business days before conversion window (owner: PM)
decisions: Canary cohort size set to 12 accounts to balance signal vs operational load (decision date: 2026-02-25)
Use structured short-form release notes + integration snippets instead of long-form doc for initial conversion communications (decision date: 2026-03-02)
Opted to surface per-account token cost in CSM dashboard but not expose to end-customer in initial phase (decision date: 2026-03-08)
